properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued August 9 at 3:51AM CDT until August 9 at 4:30AM CDT by NWS Sioux Falls SD
properties.description:
At 351 AM CDT, a severe thunderstorm was located near Fostoria, or
near Spencer In Clay County, moving northeast at 20 mph.

HAZARD...Ping pong ball size hail and 60 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...People and animals outdoors will be injured. Expect hail
damage to roofs, siding, windows, and vehicles. Expect wind
damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

Locations impacted include...
Terril and Lost Island Lake.
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.

To report severe weather contact your nearest law enforcement agency.
They will send your report to the National Weather Service office in
Sioux Falls.

NWSheadline: A SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WARNING REMAINS IN EFFECT UNTIL 430 AM CDT FOR SOUTHEASTERN DICKINSON AND NORTHEASTERN CLAY COUNTIES
